Instructor notes

Run of show for the Quarto class

Note

For Dr. B. Students may read it afterwards; nothing here is secret, it is just the plan.

Before class

  1. Open the project by double-clicking brew-and-bytes-showcase.Rproj.
  2. Build pane, Render Website. Every page, the PDF and both decks render in about a minute.
  3. Open _site/index.html in a browser and keep these tabs ready: Home, How a .qmd works, One source three outputs (plus its PDF and its slides from the Other Formats box), Slides, GitHub and Netlify.
  4. Have the student template folder open in a second RStudio window so the “your version starts empty” comparison is one Alt-Tab away.
  5. Packages needed: tidyverse only. No LaTeX: the PDF is produced by Typst, which ships inside Quarto.

The 50-minute plan

Time Page What you do The one point
0:00 Home Read the business question aloud, show the navbar A project is a question and five pages that answer it
0:05 How a .qmd works Source left, render right; change the title live; show inline R Edit, render, look. Numbers are computed, never typed
0:15 Data Scroll the cleaning section The four moves: show, count, decide, say why
0:22 Exploration Read two chart titles aloud Action titles and the so-what sentence
0:28 One source, three outputs Click PDF, click slides, come back Same file, three audiences, zero retyping
0:35 Slides Present three slides, press O for overview, swap the theme live and re-render Slides are just another output
0:42 GitHub and Netlify Walk the seven-item checklist Push or it does not exist
0:48 Template window Show the empty template: same pages, their content Start tonight

Live moments that land

  • In “How a .qmd works”, change nrow(cafe) to ncol(cafe) inside the inline sentence and render: the sentence rewrites itself.
  • In “One source, three outputs”, open the YAML, point at the three formats, then click the PDF link in the rendered page.
  • In Slides, change theme: simple to theme: moon, render, and show the deck again.
  • In the Exploration page, unfold one chart’s code to show it is the same ggplot they wrote in the WCCs.

If something breaks

  • A page fails to render: the error names the chunk. Fix or set #| eval: false on that chunk and move on.
  • The PDF link is missing: run quarto render report.qmd alone from the Terminal tab and refresh.
  • The deck opens blank: press F5 in the browser; revealjs occasionally needs one reload after a fresh render.

::: {.callout-note}
For Dr. B. Students may read it afterwards; nothing here is secret, it is just the plan.
:::

## Before class

1. Open the project by double-clicking `brew-and-bytes-showcase.Rproj`.
2. Build pane, Render Website. Every page, the PDF and both decks render in about a minute.
3. Open `_site/index.html` in a browser and keep these tabs ready: Home, How a .qmd works, One source three outputs (plus its PDF and its slides from the Other Formats box), Slides, GitHub and Netlify.
4. Have the student template folder open in a second RStudio window so the "your version starts empty" comparison is one Alt-Tab away.
5. Packages needed: `tidyverse` only. No LaTeX: the PDF is produced by Typst, which ships inside Quarto.

## The 50-minute plan

| Time | Page | What you do | The one point |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00 | Home | Read the business question aloud, show the navbar | A project is a question and five pages that answer it |
| 0:05 | How a .qmd works | Source left, render right; change the title live; show inline R | Edit, render, look. Numbers are computed, never typed |
| 0:15 | Data | Scroll the cleaning section | The four moves: show, count, decide, say why |
| 0:22 | Exploration | Read two chart titles aloud | Action titles and the so-what sentence |
| 0:28 | One source, three outputs | Click PDF, click slides, come back | Same file, three audiences, zero retyping |
| 0:35 | Slides | Present three slides, press `O` for overview, swap the theme live and re-render | Slides are just another output |
| 0:42 | GitHub and Netlify | Walk the seven-item checklist | Push or it does not exist |
| 0:48 | Template window | Show the empty template: same pages, their content | Start tonight |

## Live moments that land

- In "How a .qmd works", change `nrow(cafe)` to `ncol(cafe)` inside the inline sentence and render: the sentence rewrites itself.
- In "One source, three outputs", open the YAML, point at the three formats, then click the PDF link in the rendered page.
- In Slides, change `theme: simple` to `theme: moon`, render, and show the deck again.
- In the Exploration page, unfold one chart's code to show it is the same ggplot they wrote in the WCCs.

## If something breaks

- A page fails to render: the error names the chunk. Fix or set `#| eval: false` on that chunk and move on.
- The PDF link is missing: run `quarto render report.qmd` alone from the Terminal tab and refresh.
- The deck opens blank: press `F5` in the browser; revealjs occasionally needs one reload after a fresh render.
